key_points: NVDA shares dropped ~22% in one day, erasing about $1.4 trillion in market cap since October.
Cathie Wood and Michael Burry trimmed or sold large NVDA positions amid the AI‑driven selloff.
The broader tech and AI rout caused a $2 trillion market loss, with NVDA among the hardest‑hit stocks.
Media headlines label the decline as the cheapest in a decade, but uncertainty about AI growth persists.
Upcoming earnings and guidance remain unclear, keeping downside pressure in the near term.
